# Documentation Index

<!-- Generated by kstack-init on {{DATE}} for {{PROJECT_NAME}}. Keep this the map, not the
     content: one line per doc, updated in the same change that adds or moves one. In a repo
     with a pre-existing docs tree, this index maps what EXISTS, in place — the canonical
     layout below is the shape for entries this init created, never a reorganization order. -->

- `001-current-state.md` — the living repo summary. Read first.
- `030-decisions/` — ADRs: durable decisions on structure, dependencies, interfaces,

- `040-prds/` — PRDs: substantial product/feature work, written before implementing.
